metadata.title: Casey's stock dips after earnings, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 hours ago
Casey's stock dips after earnings, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Wednesday's premarket action:
Shares of Casey's General Stores are down more than 8% after the convenience-store chain's earnings were bolstered by strong fuel margins while sales growth inside its outlets slowed.
Braze shares are down 11% after the cloud-based software group's earnings beat expectations but it forecast third quarter profits below analyst estimates.
Shares of crypto hoarder Strategy are up 3% in heavy volume, while Robinhood stock is adding 2%, as the price of bitcoin moves back up towards the $80,000 mark.
Apple shares are barely changed as investors sit on their hands ahead of the company's iPhone event later Wednesday.
Meta Platforms stock is up nearly 5% as investors warm to the idea of the Facebook owner's new agentic AI product called Muse.
